name: William Chamberlayne
credit: Portrait: unknown artist — CC BY 4.0 (Wikimedia Commons)
bio: William Chamberlayne (1619–1689) was a physician of Shaftesbury in Dorset who is recorded as having fought on the royalist side at Newbury.
He is remembered for Pharonnida (1659), a long heroic poem in rhymed couplets, which is given here in full.
